Method of Attack: Exploit of CVE-2017-11882 in Microsoft Office Equation Editor for remote code execution
Delivery of portable executable (PE) file running in memory
Info stealer searching for passwords and access tokens in system registry
Sending stolen data to command and control server
Impacted Systems: Systems with email clients (IncrediMail, PostBox, Outlook)
Attack Vector: Spearphishing email with malicious Excel spreadsheet exploiting CVE-2017-11882
Indicators of Compromise: Excel spreadsheet with embedded exploit code
